label: Page Scroll
description: A long page -- a full-page screenshot of a landing page, a long email, a doc -- scrolled like a reader would: glide, settle on a section, glide on, in a browser window sized to the frame, a scrollbar tracking the position and an optional caption landing at each stop.

stops.label: Scroll stops: {at (s), to (0 = top .. 1 = bottom), caption, duration}; default three even stops to the bottom

at.label: Seconds into the scene it enters (default 0.2)
